criterion: With an available Surveyor layer loaded in GIS using its default configuration, the layer legend shows the Surveyor layer name and a Display Settings control.
steps_taken: Navigated to the exact launcher route and captured the loaded launcher before interaction.
Clicked Open GIS; scrolled Surveyor into view and captured the GIS state before adding the layer.
Clicked Surveyor to open configuration; captured default Service / Last 30 days configuration without changing any option.
Clicked Add layer and waited for the Surveyor - Service legend and Display Settings control.
Verified Surveyor - Service appears in the map layer list and legend, with Display Settings available; captured final screenshot and read current browser URL.
Removed the test-created layer and returned to launcher.
reason: The default Surveyor - Service layer was listed and its legend displayed its name and Display Settings.

reason: Show linked sites was visibly checked in Display Settings.

Pressed Escape. The first cleanup tool call timed out during automatic approval review; returning to GIS showed the test layer still present, so removed it using its visible Remove from selected control. Verified no layer-name or removal-control matches remained, then returned to launcher.
reason: Show linked sites was checked both before closing and after reopening the same layer's panel in one uninterrupted criterion run; no checkbox change or layer re-add occurred.
